workflow_sequence.description: RefactorPlanLoaded — the maintainer reads gaps.md and the current-reality audit, identifying dead orchestrator modules, missing common hooks, the omitted output-directory instruction, and logging-config wiring gaps.

DeadModuleSafetyValidated — static import and architecture scans confirm no external callers import the targeted orchestrator modules, tests, or config files, and that common equivalents cover the live surface.

CommonSkillActivityExtended — common/skill_activity.py gains typed no-op hooks, a compatibility run_skill helper, and a build_prompt that appends the output-directory instruction before any modify_prompt hook.

handshake_points.data_shape: {execute_hooks: [modify_sentinel_path, modify_prompt (output-dir instruction baked in), modify_harness_config, modify_invocation_context, modify_output_path, modify_result], run_skill: Callable[[SkillActivityInput, *, output_path_key: str, harness: Harness, repo_root: Path, expected_output_path: Callable | None], SkillActivityOutput]}

workflow_sequence.description: CommonLoggingSetupPorted — common/workflow_logger.py exposes setup_worker_logging(config) and all log contexts accept an optional WorkflowLoggerConfig; missing or unknown-key configs fall back to safe hardcoded defaults.

handshake_points.data_shape: setup_worker_logging(config: WorkflowLoggerConfig | None) -> None; activity_log_context, workflow_log_context, client_log_context accept optional WorkflowLoggerConfig

workflow_sequence.description: OrchestratorLoggingConfigWired — orchestrator/worker.py loads src/orchestrator/workflow_logging.config.json into a WorkflowLoggerConfig and passes it to common.setup_worker_logging before the Cadence Worker topology starts.

handshake_points.data_shape: WorkflowLoggerConfig {log_root: Path, worker_level: str, workflow_level: str, client_level: str, activity_level: str, devin_level: str}

workflow_sequence.description: OrchestratorDuplicatesRemoved — the dead orchestrator modules, tests, config files, and stale documentation identified in gaps.md are deleted after common replacements pass tests; a static architecture test rejects any lingering imports.

handshake_points.data_shape: {removed_paths: [repo-relative path, ...], static_test: 'test_architecture asserts no stale orchestrator imports'}

workflow_sequence.description: CommonTestCoverageExpanded — common tests are added for workflow/client contexts, log path helpers, stdout/stderr capture to devin.log, SkillActivityOutput log-path fields, prompt instruction ordering, hook validation, and safe defaults.

handshake_points.data_shape: {test_files: [test_workflow_logger.py, test_devin_harness.py, test_skill_activity.py], new_assertions: [workflow_log_context_file_creation, client_log_context_file_creation, get_workflow_log_path, get_client_log_path, stdout_stderr_in_devin_log, activity_log_path/devin_log_path_in_output, output_directory_instruction_before_modify_prompt, safe_defaults_for_missing_config]}

workflow_sequence.description: FullRegressionVerified — nix-shell pytest passes for the common, orchestrator, and story_analysis_workflow test suites; unit and end-to-end tests assert the expected log layout, and live full-stack workflow log-tree verification is documented as not available in CI.

handshake_points.data_shape: {pytest_scope: [src/common/tests, src/orchestrator/tests, src/story_analysis_workflow/tests], live_full_stack_log_tree: 'out of CI scope'}

new_responsibilities.responsibility: Own the generic SkillActivity lifecycle with typed no-op transformation hooks and a run_skill compatibility helper.
new_responsibilities.intent: Workflow-agnostic activity execution belongs in common per ADR-013 and ADR-014; hooks let workflow packages customize behavior without forking the template.

new_responsibilities.responsibility: Append the output-directory instruction to the default prompt before any modify_prompt hook is applied.
new_responsibilities.intent: The instruction is a generic harness hint, not a workflow-specific convention, and must be visible to the hook.

new_responsibilities.responsibility: Provide setup_worker_logging and per-execution log contexts that accept an orchestrator-supplied WorkflowLoggerConfig or safe defaults.
new_responsibilities.intent: Common owns the logging mechanism; the orchestrator owns the configuration object and file, and tests may pass explicit configs.

new_responsibilities.responsibility: Capture Devin CLI stdout/stderr to devin.log and expose activity/client/workflow/devin log path helpers.
new_responsibilities.intent: Observability of harness execution is generic and needed by all workflow packages.

new_responsibilities.responsibility: Validate per-Activity harness.devin settings with secure defaults and reject unsupported permission modes.
new_responsibilities.intent: DevinHarness is the generic CLI adapter; least-privilege defaults and strict validation belong with the harness.

new_responsibilities.responsibility: Load src/orchestrator/workflow_logging.config.json and construct a WorkflowLoggerConfig to pass to common.setup_worker_logging during worker startup.
new_responsibilities.intent: The orchestrator is the composition root and owns process-level deployment configuration; it has the config file path and runtime context.

new_responsibilities.responsibility: Start the Cadence Worker topology only after logging is configured.
new_responsibilities.intent: Runtime sequencing belongs to the composition root.

new_responsibilities.responsibility: Remove dead duplicate orchestrator modules, tests, config files, and stale docs once static tests confirm no external callers.
new_responsibilities.intent: The orchestrator layer must not retain workflow-agnostic code once it has moved to common.

new_responsibilities.responsibility: Retain only composition, catalog, and Worker lifecycle logic.
new_responsibilities.intent: ADR-013 restricts the orchestrator to composition-root responsibilities.

new_responsibilities.responsibility: Keep per-Activity harness.devin settings in colocated .config.json files.
new_responsibilities.intent: Activity-specific configuration belongs with the Activity; central overrides are not ported.

new_responsibilities.responsibility: Import common harness, skill-activity, and logging APIs and never import orchestrator modules.
new_responsibilities.intent: ADR-013 enforces the common <- workflow package <- orchestrator dependency boundary.

new_responsibilities.responsibility: Implement concrete expected_output_path for domain-specific fallback when a sentinel is missing.
new_responsibilities.intent: Domain output-path rules live in the workflow package, not common.

new_responsibilities.responsibility: Expand common tests to cover logging contexts, path helpers, stdout/stderr capture, SkillActivityOutput fields, and prompt instruction ordering.
new_responsibilities.intent: Behavior gaps must be filled before the dead orchestrator test suites are removed.

new_responsibilities.responsibility: Add a static test that fails if any source file imports a removed orchestrator module.
new_responsibilities.intent: Detects stale imports after deletion (analysis edge case).

new_responsibilities.responsibility: Run the full pytest suite for common, orchestrator, and story_analysis_workflow.
new_responsibilities.intent: Confirms the refactor does not break existing behavior.

new_responsibilities.responsibility: Store the gaps.md refactor plan and orchestrator-owned workflow_logging.config.json.
new_responsibilities.intent: Configuration and planning artifacts are persisted and version-controlled.

new_responsibilities.responsibility: Track removed paths and maintain .gitignore for .process/logs.
new_responsibilities.intent: Log files are generated artifacts and must not be committed; dead files are removed from the tree.

contracts.name: WorkflowLoggerConfig
contracts.description: Immutable orchestrator-owned configuration for log root and per-category levels. The orchestrator constructs it from src/orchestrator/workflow_logging.config.json and passes it to common logging setup and contexts.

changes.added: Optional config parameter on common.setup_worker_logging and on activity/workflow/client log contexts; module-level default config used when no explicit config is supplied
changes.modified: Config file ownership remains in src/orchestrator/workflow_logging.config.json; common no longer depends on a missing common/workflow_logging.config.json by default
changes.removed: Duplicate orchestrator WorkflowLoggerConfig class (the common class becomes canonical)

contracts.name: SkillActivityTemplateMethod
contracts.description: Fixed SkillActivity.execute lifecycle with typed no-op transformation hooks and a standalone run_skill helper. Workflows subclass SkillActivity or call run_skill to invoke a skill through a Harness.

changes.added: modify_sentinel_path, modify_prompt, modify_harness_config, modify_invocation_context, modify_output_path, modify_result hooks; run_skill(skill_input, *, output_path_key, harness, repo_root, expected_output_path=None) helper returning SkillActivityOutput
changes.modified: build_prompt appends the output-directory instruction before modify_prompt is invoked

contracts.name: WorkerLoggingSetup
contracts.description: Common API that receives an orchestrator-constructed WorkflowLoggerConfig and configures the worker process and all log contexts. Missing config or unknown top-level keys fall back to safe defaults.

changes.added: common.workflow_logger.setup_worker_logging(config: WorkflowLoggerConfig | None) -> None; module-level default config shared with log contexts
changes.modified: orchestrator/worker.py calls setup_worker_logging before run_worker_topology; orchestrator/workflow_logging.config.json is loaded by the orchestrator, not common

contracts.name: DevinHarnessConfig
contracts.description: Per-Activity Devin CLI profile resolved from the harness.devin namespace of the colocated Activity .config.json. File-based per-skill overrides from orchestrator/devin_harness.config.json are not ported.

changes.added: Validation of model and supported permission_mode (auto, accept-edits, dangerous, bypass); secure hardcoded defaults when harness.devin is missing
changes.modified: permission_mode defaults to auto; accept-edits must be explicitly declared per Activity config
changes.removed: orchestrator/devin_harness.config.json defaults and per-skill skills map

contracts.name: SkillActivityOutputLogPaths
contracts.description: SkillActivityOutput already includes activity_log_path and devin_log_path; the implementation ensures these fields are populated and the underlying files are created inside activity_log_context.

changes.added: Tests assert activity_log_path and devin_log_path are non-empty and that activity.log and devin.log exist after execute
changes.modified: DevinHarness writes stdout/stderr to devin.log regardless of exit code

contracts.name: DeadModuleRemoval
contracts.description: Process for deleting legacy orchestrator modules, tests, config, and documentation after confirming common equivalents pass and no external callers remain.

changes.added: Static architecture test that fails on any import of removed orchestrator paths; explicit deletion target list in gaps.md
changes.modified: Common test suites absorb behavior coverage before orchestrator tests are deleted
changes.removed: src/orchestrator/harness.py, devin_harness.py, skill_activity.py, workflow_logger.py, invocation_context.py, skill_activity_config.py, devin_harness.config.json, workflow_logging.config.json, orchestrator tests, README.md, vault/services/orchestrator-harness.md

architectural_decisions.decision: Do not port file-based Devin harness overrides from orchestrator/devin_harness.config.json; require every Activity .config.json to declare its own harness.devin settings.
architectural_decisions.justification: Central per-skill maps put workflow-specific knowledge in common and violate ADR-014 colocation. The four Story Analysis Activities already declare harness.devin.permission_mode=accept-edits, so the central file is redundant.
architectural_decisions.basis: ADR-012 and ADR-014; analysis question 1; story_analysis_workflow/activities/*.config.json all contain harness.devin.permission_mode
architectural_decisions.impact: Removes orchestrator/devin_harness.config.json; common DevinHarnessConfig validates the per-Activity namespace.
architectural_decisions.answers_open_question: Should the file-based Devin harness overrides from orchestrator/devin_harness.config.json be ported into common, or should every Activity .config.json carry the needed harness.devin settings?

architectural_decisions.decision: Move setup_worker_logging and the log context implementation to common while keeping WorkflowLoggerConfig construction and the config file in the orchestrator.
architectural_decisions.justification: Common owns generic logging mechanisms per ADR-013; the orchestrator owns process-level deployment configuration. Passing a config object decouples common from the config file location.
architectural_decisions.basis: ADR-011 and ADR-013; analysis questions 3 and 4
architectural_decisions.impact: Adds common.setup_worker_logging(config); orchestrator/worker.py loads workflow_logging.config.json and passes the object to common.
architectural_decisions.answers_open_question: Is the setup_worker_logging() API still required, and if so, should it be ported to common and called from orchestrator/worker.py?

architectural_decisions.decision: Bake the output-directory instruction into common/skill_activity.py build_prompt before the modify_prompt hook is applied.
architectural_decisions.justification: The instruction is a safe default for harness output placement and must be present before any hook can alter the prompt.
architectural_decisions.basis: ADR-014 template method and analysis question 2
architectural_decisions.impact: Common build_prompt appends the instruction; modify_prompt receives the enriched prompt.
architectural_decisions.answers_open_question: How should the prompt output-directory instruction from orchestrator/skill_activity.py be handled in common?

architectural_decisions.decision: Add typed no-op transformation hooks and a run_skill compatibility helper to common SkillActivity equivalent to the legacy orchestrator version.
architectural_decisions.justification: External callers may depend on the hook surface and run_skill helper; keeping them in common preserves the public API while the fixed execute lifecycle remains unchanged.
architectural_decisions.basis: ADR-014 and the existing orchestrator/skill_activity.py implementation
architectural_decisions.impact: Common SkillActivity gains modify_* hooks and run_skill; the orchestrator copy is deleted.

architectural_decisions.decision: Delete the legacy orchestrator harness, devin_harness, skill_activity, workflow_logger, invocation_context, and skill_activity_config modules and their tests/config/docs once common replacements and static tests pass.
architectural_decisions.justification: No external callers exist (analysis question 5), and retaining duplicates violates the three-layer target architecture.
architectural_decisions.basis: ADR-013 target architecture; gaps.md dead-duplicate list; analysis question 5
architectural_decisions.impact: src/orchestrator shrinks to composition-root code; common becomes the canonical generic infrastructure.
architectural_decisions.answers_open_question: Are there external callers outside this repository that still import the orchestrator skill_activity, harness, or workflow_logger modules?

architectural_decisions.decision: Use the common WorkflowLoggerConfig dataclass as the canonical configuration object and have the orchestrator import and construct it.
architectural_decisions.justification: Renaming to WorkflowLoggingConfig would create a duplicate concept; a single class in common with an optional orchestrator alias avoids divergence.
architectural_decisions.basis: common/workflow_logger.py WorkflowLoggerConfig definition and the analysis naming note
architectural_decisions.impact: No new WorkflowLoggingConfig class; orchestrator constructs common.WorkflowLoggerConfig from its config file.

architectural_decisions.decision: When no orchestrator WorkflowLoggerConfig is supplied, common.setup_worker_logging and log contexts fall back to safe hardcoded defaults and emit a warning.
architectural_decisions.justification: Defensive behavior for tests, misconfigured workers, and standalone usage; defaults match current DEFAULT_LEVELS and DEFAULT_LOG_ROOT.
architectural_decisions.basis: Analysis edge case 'Orchestrator does not pass a WorkflowLoggingConfig' and current common/workflow_logger.py defaults
architectural_decisions.impact: setup_worker_logging(config=None) and context managers with config=None use safe defaults and log a warning.

architectural_decisions.decision: setup_worker_logging stores a module-level default WorkflowLoggerConfig for use by log contexts when no explicit config is passed.
architectural_decisions.justification: Runtime worker_log_context is called inside orchestrator/runtime.py without a config argument; a default set at startup lets contexts use the orchestrator config without plumbing it through every call site.
architectural_decisions.basis: Current orchestrator/runtime.py calls common.worker_log_context with only domain and task_list
architectural_decisions.impact: common.workflow_logger keeps a module-level default config; log contexts fall back to it when no explicit config is supplied.
architectural_decisions.answers_open_question: How does common setup_worker_logging share the orchestrator config with runtime contexts?

architectural_decisions.decision: Document live full-stack workflow log-tree verification as out of CI scope for this component and rely on unit and end-to-end tests for log-path and file-creation assertions.
architectural_decisions.justification: A long-running Cadence stack is not available in CI; unit tests cover context creation and file layout deterministically.
architectural_decisions.basis: Analysis question 6 and gaps.md verification section
architectural_decisions.impact: Acceptance criteria note; no CI pipeline change for live logs.
architectural_decisions.answers_open_question: How should the live workflow log tree be verified in CI without a long-running Cadence stack?

architectural_decisions.decision: Add a static architecture test that fails if any source file imports a removed orchestrator module after deletion.
architectural_decisions.justification: Runtime tests cannot catch conditional or transitive stale imports; static source scanning fails deterministically before deployment.
architectural_decisions.basis: Analysis edge case 'A stale orchestrator import remains after dead files are deleted' and ADR-013 dependency rules
architectural_decisions.impact: New or updated test in src/orchestrator/tests/test_architecture.py or src/common/tests/test_dependencies.py; list of forbidden import prefixes updated.

questions_addressed.question: Should the file-based Devin harness overrides (defaults and per-skill skills) from orchestrator/devin_harness.config.json be ported into common, or should every Activity .config.json carry the needed harness.devin settings?
questions_addressed.answer: Do not port file-based overrides. Every Activity .config.json is responsible for its own harness.devin settings because the activity determines the necessary configuration.
questions_addressed.justification: Colocating harness settings with the Activity preserves the ADR-014 boundary and removes a central skill-name map from common.
questions_addressed.basis: ADR-012, ADR-014, and analysis question 1; story_analysis_workflow/activities/*.config.json already contain harness.devin settings

questions_addressed.question: How should the prompt output-directory instruction from orchestrator/skill_activity.py be handled in common?
questions_addressed.answer: Bake the output-directory instruction into the default prompt format in common/skill_activity.py build_prompt, appending it before the modify_prompt hook is invoked.
questions_addressed.justification: The instruction is a generic harness hint and must be present before any hook can alter the prompt.
questions_addressed.basis: ADR-014 template method and analysis question 2

questions_addressed.question: Is the setup_worker_logging() API still required, and if so, should it be ported to common and called from orchestrator/worker.py?
questions_addressed.answer: Yes, port setup_worker_logging() to common. The orchestrator calls it and passes an orchestrator-owned WorkflowLoggerConfig object.
questions_addressed.justification: Common owns generic logging mechanisms; the orchestrator owns deployment configuration. Passing the config object decouples the mechanism from the config file location.

questions_addressed.question: Should workflow_logging.config.json be copied or moved from src/orchestrator to src/common?
questions_addressed.answer: WorkflowLoggerConfig belongs to the orchestrator. The orchestrator reads workflow_logging.config.json and constructs the config object, then passes it to common's setup_worker_logging. The file stays orchestrator-owned.
questions_addressed.justification: The orchestrator is the composition root with deployment context; common should not depend on a specific config file path.
questions_addressed.basis: Analysis question 4 and current orchestrator/worker.py startup flow

questions_addressed.question: Are there external callers outside this repository that still import the orchestrator skill_activity, harness, or workflow_logger modules?
questions_addressed.answer: No external callers exist, so the orchestrator copies can be fully deleted.
questions_addressed.justification: Static scans and the current repository structure show all consumers are inside this repo and have common-layer replacements.
questions_addressed.basis: Analysis question 5 and gaps.md dead-duplicate list

questions_addressed.question: How should the live workflow log tree be verified in CI without a long-running Cadence stack?
questions_addressed.answer: Live full-stack workflow log tree verification is not available in CI. Rely on unit and end-to-end tests and document that live verification is out of scope for this component.
questions_addressed.justification: CI cannot run a long-running Cadence stack; unit tests can deterministically assert log context creation and file layout.
questions_addressed.basis: Analysis question 6 and gaps.md verification section

questions_addressed.question: How does common setup_worker_logging share the orchestrator config with runtime log contexts?
questions_addressed.answer: setup_worker_logging stores the supplied WorkflowLoggerConfig as a module-level default; log contexts use this default when no explicit config is passed.
questions_addressed.justification: This avoids changing every runtime call site while still letting tests and standalone callers pass explicit configs.
questions_addressed.basis: Current orchestrator/runtime.py calls common.worker_log_context with only domain and task_list

questions_addressed.question: What happens when an Activity .config.json omits harness.devin settings or the orchestrator omits WorkflowLoggerConfig?
questions_addressed.answer: DevinHarnessConfig uses secure hardcoded defaults (SWE-1.7 model, auto permission mode), and common.setup_worker_logging uses safe default levels and log root. Both cases log a warning but do not crash.
questions_addressed.justification: Defensive defaults preserve least privilege and keep the worker operational when configuration is incomplete.
questions_addressed.basis: Analysis edge cases and current common/devin_harness.py DEFAULT_MODEL/DEFAULT_PERMISSION_MODE and common/workflow_logger.py DEFAULT_LEVELS

questions_addressed.question: How should unknown keys in an orchestrator-provided logging config be handled?
questions_addressed.answer: Ignore unknown top-level keys for forward compatibility, while validating known keys and falling back to safe defaults for missing or invalid values.
questions_addressed.justification: Forward compatibility lets the orchestrator add new log categories without breaking common; invalid known values must not silently produce unsafe behavior.
questions_addressed.basis: Analysis edge case 'WorkflowLoggingConfig contains unknown keys' and existing forward-compatible parsing pattern in common/devin_harness.py for harness namespace
